title: Validate ordinary E134 translated drawing
changes: Exercise the retained ordinary E134 startup draw with the sprite patch explicitly disabled after checkpoint loading, supplementing observed draw entries and instrumenting direct generated-API reads.
validation: Windows GNU build e134-ordinary-native-draw-retry-build-uqwxsqrp and Wine e134-ordinary-native-draw-retry-wine-an9unydr pass. All 19 sequence-selected headers receive 133 direct generated-API reads during translated draw dispatch; 16143 bank requests are typed with zero raw, unclassified or dropped requests. Across 160 raw/managed frames, complete state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five nonempty audio streams match with bank source spans altered. The interpreter scout observes 212 draw instructions; nine missing entries are temporarily supplemented. Protected inputs pass, Wine drains and successful scratch is removed.
limitations: This configuration disables the sprite patch after loading a checkpoint created with it enabled and uses an explicitly labeled translation with nine supplemented entries. It does not prove default-hook or default production-cache behavior, exact native load PCs, full final hold or other consumers. Linux, USA and native Windows remain deferred.
Initial unit oq_fqrl_ stopped before the comparison because checkpoint loading restored the enabled sprite patch; the corrected test disables it after loading in both arms.
